decisions.text: type table: a table alone: its sole use is looking up individual values (facts.message lookup_only; G1.12)

a table alone, formatted in the book's order: the digits the purpose needs, two thin rules, space between rows and columns, the numbers right-aligned to be compared, nothing bold but the title, the unit once in the title (08-12 DP-4, G7.37–G7.45)
digits: to the measure's precision, 1, one number of decimals down each column (G7.37, G6.16)
dates written with day, month and year of fixed width (05-Jan-2021), so that their parts line up down the column (G6.21, D-32 columns (a))
the totals last under the darker rule, named in the names' column, in regular weight (D-52 (ii)); the printed totals are the data's, never recomputed
Total: a total column, set apart by a wider gutter (30 pt against 15 pt; G7.39s)
3 cells that matter on a light grey fill, nothing else changed: Northwest of Pancake Breakfast, South of 10K Run, Central of TV Raffle (G7.44)
the unit once, in the title; the cells bare numbers (G7.45)

source.shows: a table alone for looking values up, formatted in the book's order: every digit (whole dollars are required), two thin rules and no grid, the rows set well apart with no stripes, a wider gutter before the Total column, dates of fixed width, the numbers right-aligned and bare, the unit once in the title, nothing bold but the title, the three outliers on a light grey fill; the dates of the book's earlier versions (21 Jul, 1 Sep: its last version has 21 Jun and 1 Oct); at 480 pt, wider than the text
